MedTech’s legal/procurement team needs a custom SLA addendum that supports a 99.5% availability commitment for the dedicated cluster we plan to reserve.

Specifically they want:
- A short addendum we can attach to the MSA/order form that enumerates the 99.5% uptime target and the remediation credits formula (per-month credits if breached).
- Evidence of recent uptime (rolling 90-day window) and an incident log summary for major outages in the past 12 months.
- Language around latency objectives for P95 token latency for model inferences (not strict SLO but target metrics).

Can Redwood provide a draft addendum and a package of evidence (uptime CSV/summary + incident log) for procurement to review? If you can attach a proposed order-form clause that we can feed to our buyers that would speed things up.

We’re targeting a signed PO by the end of June; happy to hop on a 30-minute call if helpful.

Adding the proposed order-form clause here (inline) so procurement has something to react to. This is intentionally concise — happy to expand wording for legal.

--- Proposed Order Form Addendum (draft) ---
1) Service Availability: Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain monthly Service Availability of at least 99.5% for the Dedicated Cluster specified in the Order Form, measured at the ingress load-balancer level across the customer’s dedicated pool. Scheduled maintenance windows (announced >= 72 hours) and force majeure events are excluded from availability calculations.
2) Remediation Credits: If Redwood fails to meet the Service Availability target for any monthly measurement period, Customer shall be eligible for service credits equal to 5% of the monthly subscription fee for each 0.1% below the 99.5% target, capped at 50% of the monthly fee for that period. Credits are Customer’s sole and exclusive remedy for availability failures.
3) Latency Targets: Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain a P95 token-return latency under 800ms for the standard model path under typical production traffic profiles. This is a target metric and not a guaranteed SLO for the purposes of credits.
4) Evidence & Reporting: Redwood will provide a rolling 90-day availability report and an incident summary covering major outages in the prior 12 months upon request.

Notes:
- We recommend adding a short definition section if MedTech needs precise measurement points (e.g., how availability is computed).
- Per-lawyers: we’ll keep the credit cap and the exclusion list explicit.

Attachments: orderform-template-redlines.docx (contains redline with bracketed values and signature block)

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
